finding.title: Compare the saved selection file hash instead of its newline-free object digest
finding.explanation: metrics.selection_sha256 is manifest.selection_sha256 = sha(selection.json). The writer uses canonical(selection)+b"\n"; digest(selection) omits the newline and also defaults ensure_ascii=True unlike the writer. Therefore valid saved selections fail the assertion and no pairs are produced.
finding.minimal_validation: Read one existing small saved selection and compare its file SHA to metrics.selection_sha256; this requires no model forward or training.
finding.resolution: Confirmed latest source compares joint.selection_sha256 == sha(selection_path) == metrics.selection_sha256; newline-free digest helper removed.
